###Deces###


```{r}
base_accident <- base_accident%>%
  mutate(Mois=factor(Mois, levels = c("jan","fev","mars","avril","mai","juin","juil","aout","sept","oct","nov","dec")))%>%
  mutate(Mois=as.numeric(Mois))


base_train <- base_accident%>%
  dplyr::slice(1:180)%>%
  select(-c(accidentologie,legers, graves, Nb_accidents))

base_test <- base_accident%>%
  dplyr::slice(181:204)%>%
  select(-c(accidentologie,legers, graves, Nb_accidents))
```


```{r}
# Préparation des matrices pour la modélisation xgboost
X_train <- model.matrix(Deces~.-1, data=base_train)

y_train <- base_train$Deces


X_test <- model.matrix(Deces~.-1, data=base_test)

y_test = base_test$Deces

cat("X_train :", nrow(X_train), "lignes\n")
cat("y_train :", length(y_train), "valeurs\n")

# Vérification des dimensions
if (nrow(X_train) != length(y_train)) {
  stop("X_train et y_train ont des tailles différentes.")
}

mat_train <- xgb.DMatrix(data=X_train, label=y_train)
mat_test <- xgb.DMatrix(data=X_test, label = y_test)

```

```{r}
# Définition du contrôle : Time Series Cross-Validation (rolling window)
time_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "timeslice",
  initialWindow = 100,     # fenêtre d'entraînement
  horizon =24 ,            # horizon de test
  fixedWindow = TRUE,
  verboseIter = FALSE,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

# Grille d’hyperparamètres
grid <- expand.grid(
  list(
    nrounds=500,
    max_depth=3,
    colsample_bytree=0.7,
    eta=c(0.01,0.05),
    gamma=0,
    min_child_weight =10,
    subsample=0.7
    #lambda = c(0,0.1,1,5),
    #alpha = c(0,0.1,1,5))
))

# Entraînement
set.seed(123)
model_deces <- train(
  x = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = time_ctrl,
  tuneGrid = grid,
  metric = "RMSE",
  lambda = 0,
  alpha=1,
  verbose=0
)
```


```{r}
# Résultat
print(model_deces)

```



```{r}
# Prédiction finale
pred <- predict(model_deces, newdata = X_test)
postResample(pred, y_test)
mape(y_test, pred)
```






```{r fig.width=10}

# Évaluer l'importance des variables
importance_matrix <- xgb.importance(feature_names = colnames(X_train), model = model_deces$finalModel)

importance_df <- as.data.frame(importance_matrix)
ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(Feature, Gain), y = Gain)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill=Gain > 0.05)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Importance des Variables avec XGBoost", x = "Variables", y = "Gain") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels =scales::percent)+
  theme(
  #axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45),
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5),
  panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
  panel.grid.major = element_line( colour="gray"),
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size=12, colour = "black"))
  # )+
  # guides(
  #   color = guide_legend(nrow=1)
  # )
ggsave("./script/var_imp_deces.pdf", device = cairo_pdf,height = 24, width = 18, units = "cm")
```

```{r}
base_accident <- base_accident%>%
  mutate(Mois=factor(Mois, levels = c("jan","fev","mars","avril","mai","juin","juil","aout","sept","oct","nov","dec")))%>%
  mutate(Mois=as.numeric(Mois))


base_train <- base_accident%>%
  dplyr::slice(1:180)%>%
  select(-c(accidentologie,legers, Deces, Nb_accidents))

base_val <- base_accident%>%
  dplyr::slice(168:180)%>%
  select(-c(accidentologie,legers, Deces, Nb_accidents))

base_test <- base_accident%>%
  dplyr::slice(181:204)%>%
  select(-c(accidentologie,legers, Deces, Nb_accidents))
```


```{r}
# Préparation des matrices pour la modélisation xgboost
X_train <- model.matrix(graves~.-1, data=base_train)

y_train <- base_train$graves

X_val <- model.matrix(graves~.-1, data=base_val)

y_val <- base_val$graves

X_test <- model.matrix(graves~.-1, data=base_test)

y_test = base_test$graves

cat("X_train :", nrow(X_train), "lignes\n")
cat("y_train :", length(y_train), "valeurs\n")

# Vérification des dimensions
if (nrow(X_train) != length(y_train)) {
  stop("X_train et y_train ont des tailles différentes.")
}

mat_train <- xgb.DMatrix(data=X_train, label=y_train)
mat_val <- xgb.DMatrix(data=X_val, label=y_val)
mat_test <- xgb.DMatrix(data=X_test, label = y_test)

```
```{r}
set.seed(123)
watchlist <- list(train = mat_train, validation = mat_test)

model_xgb <- xgb.train(
  params = list(
    objective = "reg:squarederror",
    eval_metric = "rmse",
    eta = 0.05,
    gamma = 0,
    max_depth = 3,
    colsample_bytree = 0.7,
    lambda = 0,
    alpha = 1,
    subsample = 0.7,
    min_child_weight = 10
  ),
  data = mat_train,
  nrounds = 500,
  watchlist = watchlist,
  early_stopping_rounds = 20,
  verbose = 0
)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
model_xgb_1 <- xgboost(data=mat_train, params = list(
  objective="reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric="rmse",
  eta=0.05,
  gamma=0,
  max_depth=3,
  colsample_bytree=0.7,
  lambda=0,
  alpha=1,
  subsample=0.7,
  min_child_weight=10),
  nrounds=500,
  verbose = 0)
```

```{r}
# Accès aux logs d'erreur
log_error <- model_xgb$evaluation_log
head(log_error)

# Tracé de la courbe d'erreur
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(log_error, aes(iter)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = train_rmse, color = "Train")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = validation_rmse, color = "Test")) +
  labs(title = "Courbe d'erreur XGBoost", x = "Itérations", y = "RMSE") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
pred <- predict(model_xgb_1, newdata = X_test)
postResample(pred, y_test)
mape(y_test, pred)
```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=8}

ggsave("./script/var_imp_graves.pdf", device = cairo_pdf,height = 24, width = 18, units = "cm")
```


```{r}
# Définition du contrôle : Time Series Cross-Validation (rolling window)
time_ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "timeslice",
  initialWindow = 100,     # fenêtre d'entraînement
  horizon =1 ,            # horizon de test
  fixedWindow = TRUE,
  verboseIter = FALSE,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

# Grille d’hyperparamètres
grid <- expand.grid(
  list(
    nrounds=500,
    max_depth=3,
    colsample_bytree=0.7,
    eta=c(0.01,0.05),
    gamma=0,
    min_child_weight =10,
    subsample=0.7
))

  x = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = time_ctrl,
  tuneGrid = grid,
  metric = "RMSE",
  lambda = 0.2,
  alpha=1,
  verbose=0
)
```

```{r}

postResample(pred, y_test)
```
